0:00.0 bar 1 · beat 1
Red tick = 3:00 mark at current BPM & song length · autosaves in this browser

Scenes

Tap a scene, then tap the Flow to place it. Double-tap a placed clip to jump in and edit it. Patterns can now be 1, 2 or 4 bars.

Channel rack — tap steps, tap a name to hear it

Every sound is synthesised fresh per hit (no stale pre-renders). Pick a channel, then shape it by words in the Create tab.

Tap empty space to write a note · drag a note to move it · drag its right tail to resize · double-tap a note to make it louder/softer.

Mixer — EQ, space, balance

Each channel has 3-band EQ plus delay & reverb sends, into a master compressor. M = mute, S = solo.

Sound check

Plays every channel on its own and measures what actually comes out. If one is silent it says why.

🔤 Sound design by words

Selected channel: · Words it understands: punchy, soft, hard, dark, bright, deep, short, long, dusty, clean + kick, snare, hat, clap, shaker, log, bass, piano, marimba, kalimba, glock, pluck, guitar, pad, strings, flute, choir.

💬 Sentence to song

Offline rules understand tempo, key, mood (sad / happy / dark / chill), instruments and drum weight. It creates a new scene — your other scenes stay untouched.

🃏 Idea cards

🎤 Listen — hum it / beatbox it (beta)

Needs mic permission. Works best quiet, close to the phone.

💾 Project, import & export

MIDI & WAV are the bridge to desktop DAWs — Tra-ap does not read or write .flp / Logic project files (see SPEC.md).
